fields.label: Resource profile
fields.description: CPU/memory budget applied to the active Loki workloads. CHART_DEFAULT keeps the chart's own behavior, SMALL/MEDIUM/LARGE apply Qovery's versioned budgets, CUSTOM enables the per-workload fields. Budgets are not capacity guarantees. Every resource field may be changed at any time; an update recompiles the Helm values and rolls the workloads.

fields.label: Single binary CPU request (millicores)
fields.description: Whole number of millicores; 500 compiles to 500m. Required for every active workload when the resource profile is CUSTOM.

fields.label: Single binary CPU limit (millicores)
fields.description: Optional whole number of millicores; must be at least the CPU request. Leave empty to run without CPU throttling.

fields.label: Single binary memory request (MiB)
fields.description: Whole number of mebibytes; 512 compiles to 512Mi. Required for every active workload when the resource profile is CUSTOM.

fields.label: Single binary memory limit (MiB)
fields.description: Optional whole number of mebibytes; must be at least the memory request. The pod is OOM-killed above this limit.
